patterns: do we have to wear uniform
responses: NU Laguna's regular uniform days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Students should wear the appropriate uniform for their program, with black shoes. Tourism, Psychology, and Exercise and Sports Science students may wear their respective program uniforms. Friday is for E-Sports uniforms with proper rubber shoes. Wednesday and Saturday are wash days — you may wear civilian clothes but must still follow the student dress code. You can buy uniforms at NU Bulldogs Exchange on campus.

responses: NU Laguna enforces a strict anti-hazing policy in line with RA 8049 (Anti-Hazing Law). To report hazing or bullying, you may approach the Discipline Office or Guidance Office on the ground floor, or email gso@nu-laguna.edu.ph.
We maintain a zero-tolerance policy on hazing. The Discipline Office and Guidance Office (ground floor) handle these reports, or you can email gso@nu-laguna.edu.ph.

patterns: How do I report a concern to the Discipline Office?
responses: The Discipline Office is on the ground floor, to the left of the elevator near the dugout. Enter the office and proceed straight to the cubicles to report your concern. The Guidance Office is in the same area; after entering, go left and follow the signs for the Guidance Office.
